case_number: 2024 INSC 836; Civil Appeal No. 12110 of 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (C) 21942 of 2024)

parties.respondent: The Director General of Health Services & Ors.

summary: Disability eligibility for MBBS admission; appellant with 88% locomotor disability challenged assessment board's opinion of ineligibility; High Court upheld board's certification; Supreme Court examined functional competence model, reasonable accommodation under RPWD Act, 2016; assessed applicability of AIIMS circular regarding inclusion of healthcare professionals with disabilities in assessment boards; considered safety concerns in clinical settings with assistive devices; evaluated conflict between statutory requirements and disability inclusion in medical education; directed re-assessment in AIIMS Delhi.
legal_provisions_cited: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
Article 136 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appellant directed to appear before medical board at AIIMS Delhi for reassessment; interim directions issued for consideration of functional competence with assistive devices; matter remanded for fresh decision in light of RPWD Act and guidelines.
